I use the app on my laptop because I find it easier to study math on a computer than on my phone, especially since I’m usually not doing math on the go. I think it would be helpful if we could use the keyboard to type in numbers instead of having to click each number with the cursor.

Another thing that would help is keeping the row operations visible after we enter them. Sometimes I forget which row operation I needed to use, and then I have to mentally work backward through the problem to figure it out again. Being able to see the row operation that we're working on would make it much easier to follow my work. (I'm not sure if that makes sense..)
